# netactuate_ddos_dashboard (Data Source)

Reads a DDoS Dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_ddos_dashboard" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_ended` (Boolean) Whether ended attacks should be included. When configured, this is sent as the include_ended query parameter.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of dashboard entries requested. When configured, this is sent as the limit query parameter.
- `period` (Number) Dashboard period in seconds. When configured, this is sent as the period query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `active_rules` (Number) Active rule count returned by the dashboard endpoint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `longest_attack_seconds` (Number) Longest attack duration in seconds returned by the dashboard endpoint.
- `top_attacks` (List of Object) Top attack entries returned by the dashboard endpoint. The element shape is intentionally minimal because the endpoint can return an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--top_attacks))
- `total_attacks` (Number) Total attack count returned by the dashboard endpoint.
